reviewer.role: Independent architectural-clay reviewer; did not author or edit builder source

scope: Offline holistic architectural-clay visual review of texture-free colored native geometry and exact-source fidelity

holistic_assessment.observation: The open front nave, brick aisle masses, barrel roof and raised monitor, central gabled side portals, green ironwork, paired galleries and market occupancy retain the locked reference identity. Fine ornament and surface finish remain simplified native geometry.

Fresh front_corner, aerial, top and architecture_close show fine curved transverse barrel framing between the larger primary ribs. Secondary curves stop on each side of the monitor; thin longitudinal divisions remain legible. Opaque aisle fields contain four discrete skylight groups per side. Portal roof outer seating and inboard triangle closures remain intact; no visible free rods, outward knee-brace prongs or glaring contact gaps.

Rear clerestory band, aisle end glazing, monitor and masonry elevations close the building; the front nave is intentionally open as in the source. No new exterior holes apparent in rear, rear_side, side elevations or roof views.

Side doorway base courses stay split and corresponding ground stalls stay removed, preserving passages. gallery_stair and gallery_landing frame the last tread, flat landing, guard termination and lateral gallery connection clearly. This is visual access evidence, not runtime collision/navigation testing.

glass_close, program_interior and walk reveal physical galleries, supports, shelves, stocked counters, table seating and open axial circulation. The new framing does not conceal the inhabited market program.

All eight whole-building views retain complete footprint/roof margins; detail views expose the relevant physical features. Fresh comparison-phone board supports the exact source/model comparison and states browser NOT TESTED. Individual images, not the reduced board alone, determined this review.

prior_findings_rechecked.observation: Fine transverse curved barrel seams are now visible at the intended 0.8 m cadence between 4 m primary ribs, split at the monitor, restoring the missing source roof rhythm.
Side entrance low stone courses and central ground-stall obstructions remain cleared.
Extended gabled portal roof seating and inboard triangular closures remain present.
Rear enclosure, bounded braces and front girder, and unobstructed stair/gallery landings retain their corrections.

checks.render_provenance: actual optimized GLB reimport; no geometry/material replacement
checks.render_provenance_basis: Builder report and authoring evidence; reviewer independently inspected the delivered render pixels and exact GLB bytes, did not rerender.

limitations: Rear and concealed interior details are inferred where the three exact sources do not expose them.
Clay review accepts simplified native materials and ornament; it does not claim finished texture fidelity.
Native-scale offline review only. Browser import, terrain placement, scaling, editing and capture remain NOT TESTED by explicit user direction.
build-report.json still records builder_visual_review and independent_review as pending. This separate signed review records the independent decision without modifying builder metadata.
next_checkpoint: No further architectural-clay correction required by this review. This exact candidate can serve as the reviewed market pilot checkpoint; separate browser/runtime and human activation gates remain outstanding.
